{{Quote|We traced her [Senator Dodonna] to the Museum of Alien History, which the Imperials are using as a POW camp. High Command doesn't want to go any further.|Sumalee|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Museum of Alien History''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located in [[Axial Park]], a district of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Imperial forces have occupied the museum and used as a makeshift camp for POWs. After high-profile Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bevera Dodonna]] was revealed as a traitor and fled to the museum, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sumalee]] authorized a mission to locate and retrieve her. [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Curske]] provided the maps of Selonian tunnels leading to the museum and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Voidhound]] went in and apprehended the traitorous Senator.
